atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapitan'ti?
bhūtam'idan'ti, sāriputta, passasī'ti? bhūtam'idan'ti, bhante, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
aho vat'āhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā'ti
anicc'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, anicc'ānupassī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati

44777.meaning1: pleasure of resting; pleasure of lying down
44777.commentary: (ANa) passasukhan'ti yathā samparivattakaṃ sayantassa dakkhiṇapassa vāmapassānaṃ sukhaṃ hoti, evaṃ uppannasukhaṃ.

examples.text: paṭibuddhena ca te, moggallāna, khippaññ'eva paccuṭṭhātabbaṃ na seyyasukhaṃ na passasukhaṃ na middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharissāmī'ti
yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāva'd'atthaṃ udar'āvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.

44778.grammar: prp, masc & nt nom sg of passanta, trans (+acc)

examples.text: so ajānaṃ vā āha jānāmī'ti, jānaṃ vā āha na jānāmī'ti, apassaṃ vā āha passāmī'ti, passaṃ vā āha na passāmī'ti
te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā, āmā'ti paṭijānanti, ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharathā'ti? iti puṭṭhā, no'ti vadanti.
iti jānāmi iti passāmī'ti jānām'ahaṃ ete dhamme, passām'ahaṃ ete dhamme, atthi ca ete dhammā mayi, ahañ'ca etesu dhammesu sandissāmī'ti.
passām'ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ ṭhānaṃ. idh'assa, bhante, pubbe pāpakammaṃ kataṃ avipakkavipākaṃ. tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan'ti.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭh'āsayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.
kāyesu kāy'aññatar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ, assāsapassāsā.

atha kho māro pāpimā brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantena jaṭ'aṇḍuvena ajinakkhipanivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghurughurupassāsī udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī
jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā.

44783.commentary: (SNa) uccārapassāvakamme'ti uccārassa ca passāvassa ca karaṇe. tattha pattakāle uccārapassāvaṃ akarontassa sakalasarīrato sedā muccanti, akkhīni bhamanti, cittaṃ na ek'aggaṃ hoti, aññe ca rogā uppajjanti.

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, evarūpena javena samannāgato evarūpena ca padavītihārena aññatr'eva asita-pīta-khāyita-sāyitā aññatra uccāra-passāvakammā aññatra niddākilamatha-paṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'va kālaṅ'kato.
duṭṭhullā nāma vācā vaccamagga-passāvamagga-methunadhammappaṭisaṃyuttā vācā.
na udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
passāv'ūpatthambhe'ti passāvena pīḷitassa aṅgajātaṃ kammaniyaṃ hoti.
tathāgatassa bhikkhusaṅghaparivutassa nagaraṃ pavisanakāle bhikkhū taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ disvā nikkhamanakāle'pi naṃ tath'eva olambantaṃ passiṃsu.

44789.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: kāḷ'ūpakāḷā vijito jito ca, aṅgo ca paṅgo ca guttijito ca, passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlaṃ, aparājito mārabalaṃ ajesi.
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti?

44791.meaning1: could be seen; should be looked at

examples.text: mayhaṃ kho sāmi dāsassa iddh'ānubhāvo khette passitabbo'ti
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti
parammukhā nisīditvā, yadi icchāmi passituṃ, uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyaṃ, sabbaṃ passāmi cakkhunā.
raho nāma cakkhussa raho, sotassa raho. cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ.

44794.meaning2: having seen, having found, having understood

examples.text: opammaṃ karohī'ti. yathā, mahārāja, rañño bhaṇḍ'āgāriko bhaṇḍ'āgāraṃ pavisitvā nīla-pīta-lohit'odāta-mañjiṭṭhāni rājabhogāni rūpāni passitvā sañjānāti. evaṃ kho, mahārāja, sañjānanalakkhaṇā saññā'ti.
yadā paṭhamam'addakkhiṃ, satthāram'akutobhayaṃ, tato me ahu saṃvego, passitvā puris'uttamaṃ.
muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī, agamī buddhavarassa santikaṃ, passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, cakkhu āsi yathā purāṇakan'ti.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedha, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu.
puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ek'āhamataṃ vā dvī'hamataṃ vā tī'hamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
dukkhassa ve maṃ pabhavaṃ apucchasi, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ, upadhinidānā pabhavanti dukkhā, ye keci lokasmim'anekarūpā.
das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.
